verdict.rationale: Workable's MCP server documentation says its coverage of the hiring lifecycle extends 'through offer approvals', which implies the product has an offer-approval capability. Nothing describes configurable multi-step approval chains, or approvals that gate job openings before they go live. The requisitions endpoint is documented only as returning a list, with no approval semantics. Missing for 10: configurable approval chain setup, approval gating for job openings before publishing, details of the offer approval workflow (approvers, sequencing, blocking send), and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an operations lead, job openings and offers route through configurable approval chains before anything goes live or gets sent

citations.quote: It covers the entire hiring lifecycle — from job management and candidate sourcing through offer approvals
